preferences.acpProviders.title: ACP providers
preferences.acpProviders.intro: Agents the AI chat panel connects to over SSH. Add a provider, generate its key, install the key line on the agent host, run Test connection, then enable it.
preferences.acpProviders.adminOnly: Only admins can manage ACP providers.
preferences.acpProviders.noKeys: Key storage is not set up on this server.
preferences.acpProviders.error.invalidIn: A value was rejected. Check each field against its hint. A slug that is already in use is rejected too.
preferences.acpProviders.error.notSuppor: Mk1 tools are not available until Phase 2.
preferences.acpProviders.error.notReady: This provider needs a passing Test connection first. Turn Enabled off and save, run Test connection, then turn Enabled on again.
preferences.acpProviders.error.providerI: This provider has chats, so it cannot be deleted. Disable it instead.
preferences.acpProviders.error.providerN: This provider no longer exists. Reload the list.
preferences.acpProviders.error.saveFaile: Could not save. Nothing was changed.
preferences.acpProviders.error.generateF: Could not generate the key. Nothing was changed.
preferences.acpProviders.error.deleteFai: Could not delete. Nothing was changed.
preferences.acpProviders.lastTest.stale: The {{at}} test no longer applies after a change. Run Test connection again.
preferences.acpProviders.displayName.des: Shown in the chat panel. 1 to 100 characters.
preferences.acpProviders.slug.label: Slug
preferences.acpProviders.slug.descriptio: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 2 to 32. Fixed once created.
preferences.acpProviders.sshHost.label: SSH host
preferences.acpProviders.sshHost.descrip: IP address or hostname of the agent host.
preferences.acpProviders.sshPort.label: SSH port
preferences.acpProviders.sshUser.label: SSH user
preferences.acpProviders.hostKey.label: Host key
preferences.acpProviders.hostKey.descrip: Paste the key type and the base64 key only, like ssh-ed25519 AAAA..., without the hostname that ssh-keyscan puts in front.
preferences.acpProviders.launcherPath.de: Absolute path on the host. Display only: it fills the authorized_keys line.
IP of this Mk1 server as the host sees it. The key only works from there.
preferences.acpProviders.sessionCwd.desc: Absolute path the agent works in.
preferences.acpProviders.idleMinutes.des: An idle chat session closes after this long. 1 to 240.
preferences.acpProviders.permissionTimeo: Mk1 denies an approval card left unanswered this long.
preferences.acpProviders.agentApprovalTi: The agent's own approval timeout. Must be above the approval timeout.
preferences.acpProviders.blocker.notSave: Save the provider, then generate a key.
preferences.acpProviders.blocker.noKey: Generate a key first, then install it on the host.
preferences.acpProviders.blocker.changed: You changed the roles or connection settings. Save, then run Test connection again.
preferences.acpProviders.blocker.unteste: A provider open to standard users needs a passing Test connection first.
preferences.acpProviders.editNote: Test connection and Generate key use the saved settings. Save or cancel first.
preferences.acpProviders.fingerprintAfte: The fingerprint shows after you save.
preferences.acpProviders.standardNote: Standard also lets non-admin users chat with it. It then needs a passing Test connection before it can be enabled.
preferences.acpProviders.retestLost: Changing the roles or connection settings removes the passing test, so this provider cannot stay enabled. Turn Enabled off to save, then test and enable it again.
preferences.acpProviders.timeoutsBad: Approval timeout must be below the agent timeout.
preferences.acpProviders.testing: Testing the connection. This can take up to two minutes.
preferences.acpProviders.confirmGenerate: Generate a new key for {{name}}? A provider open to standard users is disabled until it passes a new test. Install the new line on the host afterwards.
preferences.acpProviders.confirmRegenera: Generate a new key for {{name}}? This replaces the existing key, so the line now installed on the host stops working. A provider open to standard users is disabled until it passes a new test. Install the new line on the host afterwards.
preferences.acpProviders.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}}? Remove its line from authorized_keys on the host too.
preferences.acpProviders.installLine: Install this line in authorized_keys on the host. It holds the public key only.
preferences.acpProviders.lineUnbuilt: The authorized_keys line could not be built. Check the launcher path and Authorized from.
preferences.acpProviders.noKeyYet: No key yet. Generate a key, install its line on the host, then run Test connection.

preferences.documents.readOnly: Only administrators can change document categories.
preferences.documents.sectionHint: Every published document belongs to one category. The prefix becomes the start of its code (ART-0012) and is permanent.
preferences.documents.spaces.sectionHint: Spaces are the first level of the Documents page and decide who can read what. A company space is readable by every login; a restricted space only by the groups you grant. General always exists and is always company-wide.
preferences.documents.spaces.accessHint: Members of a granted group can read every document in this space. Visibility is per space, not per document.
preferences.documents.spaces.noGroups: No active groups yet. Create one in the Groups pane first.
preferences.documents.spaces.generalNote: General cannot be restricted, deactivated or deleted.
preferences.groups.readOnly: Only administrators can change user groups.
preferences.groups.sectionHint: Groups decide who can see and edit restricted boards, and who can see the flags raised on them. Admins see everything. Never put a secret on a board.
preferences.groups.membersHint: Stream visibility changes apply when the app reconnects.
preferences.sampleForms.sectionHint: The dosage forms a peptide sample can be filed under. New peptide samples get the default form and a retest keeps its original's. Forms are never deleted: deactivate one to stop offering it. Samples already holding it keep it.
preferences.sampleForms.empty: No sample forms yet. Add the first one below.
preferences.sampleForms.orderHint: Where the form sits in the Form pickers at check-in and on the sample page. Lower numbers come first.
preferences.sampleForms.deactivateDefaul: Make another form the default first.
preferences.flags.typesDescription: Types offered when raising a flag. Recolor, scope to entities, or deactivate. Existing flags keep a deactivated type's color.
preferences.flags.readOnly: You have read-only access to flag settings.
preferences.flags.label: Label
preferences.flags.deactivateInstead: In use or built-in — deactivate it instead of deleting.
preferences.flags.help.issue: something is wrong and needs action before the work proceeds (e.g. Blocker, Critical, Question, Waiting on Customer). Issues expect an assignee and a resolution.
preferences.flags.help.signal: a hand-off that nothing is wrong — it marks a state change others should see (e.g. Ready for Verification). Signals inform; they don't demand a fix.
preferences.flags.help.scope: — where the type is offered when raising a flag. "All" means every flaggable item; picking specific item types hides it elsewhere.
preferences.flags.help.deactivate: deactivating hides a type from the raise picker while existing flags keep rendering with it (audit-safe). Built-in or in-use types can't be deleted — deactivate them instead.
preferences.flags.recurring.title: Recurring tasks
preferences.flags.recurring.description: Templates that automatically raise a flag on a schedule (e.g. weekly HPLC calibration).
preferences.flags.recurring.skipIfOpen: Skip if previous is still open
preferences.flags.recurring.skipIfOpenHi: don't mint a new flag while the last one it created is still unresolved.
preferences.flags.scope.title: Type availability
preferences.flags.scope.description: Drag a flag type onto an item to restrict it to that item, or onto All items to make it global. A type can sit in several buckets; use the ✕ on a chip to remove it from one.
preferences.flags.items.title: Items
preferences.flags.items.description: Virtual categories a general task can attach to (e.g. Purchase Task). Rename, recolor, or deactivate. Existing flags keep a deactivated kind's label.
preferences.slack.title: Slack notifications
preferences.slack.blurb: Get flag notifications as Slack DMs — assignments, mentions, and activity on flags you raised or watch.
preferences.slack.notify_assigned: When a flag is assigned to me
